programs.description: Narsinh Mehta is a poet and saint of Gujarat, who is just like any other person facing several hardships and struggles in his life.
Vama and Jayant attempt to secure good jobs, but things don't go their way. Later, Vama receives a call from a friend with a massive stock market tip.
After receiving the tip, Vama believes that this could be a life-changing moment. Soon, she begins planning her next move.
Coming face to face with the big bull, Vama takes her planning a bit further.
Stocks are rising, the strategy worked, and everyone is pleased, except for Vikram Ghosh. There is something that troubles him.
There are two sides to a coin, one side everyone has seen, now it's the turn of the other side.
Aaditya, Aakash and Aanand are close friends addicted to smoking and drinking. However, their wild routine takes a turn when mysterious strangers enter their circle.

After the final evening of celebration, everyone returns to work. It's revealed that Aadarsh, Aakash's elder brother, made a bold sacrifice to save him—one that ends in failure and changes everything.
Aadarsh, trying to recover money lost over forced alcohol purchases, attempts to control the chaos. As he makes compromises, the group spirals into confusion and disappointment.
As debts pile up and Salim Bhai's pressure mounts, the group rethinks their choices. After paying off most dues, they plan a trip, hoping to escape the chaos of recent weeks.
The friends must understand soon that the challenging task will destroy their lives.
Mukesh Bhambhani and his spouse Neeta participate in an amusing domestic dispute. Consequently, this entertaining rivalry generates immense laughter.
